summary: Wave 60 verification — Live Commission Breakdown UI + Seller Application UX + branded password-reset endpoint. Backend smoke + source-level code review approach. Did NOT create/approve a fresh supplier this iteration because (a) previous iterations explicitly note no shared supplier exists and ask to create-and-cleanup only on demand, (b) full cleanup (Supabase Auth + suppliers + suppliers_pending + users tables + AI-job artefacts) is risky from a sub-agent, and (c) all the rendered DOM is fully deterministic from the source — every form passes a testIdPrefix to a single shared PriceWithGstToggle component whose payout-breakdown block is unconditionally rendered when typed>0 && priceType is set. All source-level checks PASS. Backend password-reset smoke PASS on live preview.

verifications_performed.Commission slab boundaries (source): PASS — commission.js L15-21 COMMISSION_TIERS: <15000→10%, <30000→8%, <75000→6%, <100000→5%, ≥100000→4%. payoutBreakdown returns rateLabel from this table. Boundaries 14999→10%, 15000→8%, 30000→6%, 75000→5%, 100000→4% all correct (the tier predicate uses `p < t.upTo` so 15000 falls into tier2 (8%), 30000 into tier3 (6%), etc — matches the spec).

action_items: If main agent wants live UI E2E proof of the {prefix}-payout-breakdown blocks rendering, register a fresh supplier (POST /api/auth/signup-customer with role upgrade via admin), approve via admin dashboard, then run a Playwright test that opens Add Toner / Add Printer / Add Paper / Add Consumable / Add Scanner forms and queries the data-testids. Be ready to delete the fresh user from Supabase Auth + users + suppliers + suppliers_pending tables afterwards.

Minor — the Printer form uses testIdPrefix='wizard' (so the testid is `wizard-payout-breakdown`, not `printer-payout-breakdown`). If product/QA wants consistency, change PrinterListings.jsx L769 to testIdPrefix='printer'. Functionally the breakdown renders correctly either way.
Minor — SellerApplicationForm.jsx L339 has a dead/no-op ternary `{(!KNOWN_CITIES.includes(s.city) && s.city !== "") || s.city === "" ? null : null}`. Always returns null. Safe to remove for tidiness.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend password-reset route returns 200 unconditionally (try/except swallows errors then returns ok:true). That's the right UX (no account-existence leak) but means email-send failures are invisible to QA. The single logger.warning at L590 is the only signal. Consider exposing a debug-only header in non-prod to flag whether the branded vs fallback path was taken.

Phone uniqueness check at routes/auth.py L246-261 catches Exception broadly and only logs at debug — if the `phone` column is missing or table is unreachable, the uniqueness gate silently no-ops and a duplicate phone CAN slip through. Recommend logger.warning + a hard 503 instead of silently allowing the insert.

Phone normalisation: client sends `+91 9876543210` (form prefixes), backend just `.strip()`s. If a re-applicant types without prefix or with a different separator (e.g. `9876543210`, `+91-9876543210`), uniqueness is bypassed. Recommend stripping all non-digits and comparing last-10 digits.

SellerApplicationForm.jsx — `step 1` does not block Next when `city === ''` but the user picked 'Other' and hasn't typed anything yet (canNext returns false because !s.city), so this is actually OK. Just flagging because the UI reads slightly confusing on first viewing.

PriceWithGstToggle — `data-testid={`${testIdPrefix}-payout-breakdown`}` is rendered ONLY when typed>0 AND priceType is set. Parent form must show the Incl./Excl. pill toggle before the dealer can see the breakdown. Confirmed all 5 wrappers do.
PrinterListings.jsx uses testIdPrefix='wizard' while every other form uses a kind-named prefix. Minor inconsistency — see action items.
